parsed.post: Breakthrough! Increasing DEPTH to 8 pushed val_bpb down to 0.8081. Capacity scaling is extremely powerful. Now that we've established depth 8 is superior, I'll probe the learning rate at this new capacity level to find the optimal convergence point.
parsed.description: Probing a lower learning rate (0.03) on the new DEPTH=8 stack to see if the higher capacity requires more stability to reach a lower minimum.
